description: This file contains functions and types for executing browser-related actions such as tabs, snapshots, console messages, and actions, with support for external content wrapping, error handling, and test dependency injection.

classes.name: __testing
classes.description: Object providing a method to override dependencies for testing purposes.

methods.name: wrapBrowserExternalJson
methods.description: Wraps payload content into external JSON with source info and warning inclusion.

methods.name: formatTabsToolResult
methods.description: Formats tab list into an AgentToolResult with wrapped external content.

methods.name: formatConsoleToolResult
methods.description: Formats console messages into an AgentToolResult with wrapped external content.

methods.name: isChromeStaleTargetError
methods.description: Determines if an error indicates a stale Chrome target based on profile and error message.

methods.name: stripTargetIdFromActRequest
methods.description: Removes targetId from a browser action request for retry purposes.

methods.name: canRetryChromeActWithoutTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a browser action request can be retried without a targetId based on its kind or action.

methods.name: executeTabsAction
methods.description: Executes a browser tabs action, either via proxy or local dependency, returning formatted result.

methods.name: executeSnapshotAction
methods.description: Performs a snapshot action with various formatting options, wrapping content, and handling image results.

methods.name: executeConsoleAction
methods.description: Fetches console messages either via proxy or local dependency and formats the result.

methods.name: executeActAction
methods.description: Performs a browser action, with error handling for stale targets and retries if applicable.
